scope: Primary-source review during health-only capture. Context for later research,not a change to frozen batch or clock controls.

sources.title: The price impact of order book events
sources.finding: In50USstocks, contemporaneous quote-based order-flow imbalance explains short-interval midpoint changes more robustly than trade volume,with sensitivity related to depth.
sources.limit: This explains movements over the same interval;it does not establish profitable future-return prediction,400ms-later execution,or ten-second reversal on Core/RH. Quote additions/cancellations matter. Our batched public messages may merge underlying events,so a quote-derived imbalance would be a proxy.

sources.title: The price impact of order book events:market orders,limit orders and cancellations
sources.finding: The paper studies interactions among trades,limit orders and cancellations;the response depends on event history and changes in subsequent book activity.
sources.limit: A large print alone cannot identify temporary impact versus continuing informed flow. Abstract reviewed;no coefficients or expected profits transferred to our venues.
